method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: Eeling 推断有与 Thomas Conlee 极亲近的人制造了压倒性证据将其陷害为 Bedfellow 案凶手。
facts.anchor: I think someone very close to Thomas Conlee framed him for the Bedfellow murders

facts.fact: Eeling 指出陷害者能自由进入 Tommy 公寓，取其 T 恤与近期用过的避孕奎证据栽赃。
facts.anchor: gathered the necessary items (i.e. his T-shirt and a recently used condom) to incriminate him.

facts.fact: Eeling 认为真凶的失误导致 Cheryl Barton 被杀。
facts.anchor: which is why Cheryl Barton was killed.

facts.fact: Eeling 指出 Cheryl 不符其他受害者特征：年轻至少五岁、金发而非深发、喉咙多处刀伤。
facts.anchor: she’s younger by at least five years, she’s blond instead of brunette

facts.fact: Eeling 认为证据将在警探 Ramsby 答应寄来的照片里。
facts.anchor: the proof will be in the photos Detective Ramsby said he would send me.

facts.fact: Eeling 写下最近几周总觉被人跟踪、无法摆脱这种感觉。
facts.anchor: there’s this overwhelming feeling someone’s following me.

facts.fact: Eeling 第一怀疑对象是 Dustin Reiten，因上次冲突，且 Dustin 曾出现在他住的酒店。
facts.anchor: My first thought was Dustin Reiten because of our last run-in.

facts.fact: Eeling 说 Dustin 想知道他如何找到他们，但他不愿在还指望 Ramsby 提供照片时供出对方。
facts.anchor: He wanted to know how I found them, but I wasn’t going to give up Ramsby

facts.fact: Eeling 急于回城市与家人 Owen、Natalie 团聚，并想向 Hattie 解释一切。
facts.anchor: Excited to get back to the city lights, and more importantly, Owen and Natalie.
